caption: Report #62's trip: standing at Prospect/Canner (stop 100), heading to Peabody/SOM (stop 97) on Blue Day. The change only bites once the planned bus becomes uncatchable and the card advances to a later one — the rider is then re-met at the nearer stop instead of being sent 7 min up to Whitney/Canner. These shots confirm the trip view and map still render normally.
